title: Dive Kit Search Sources Schema
description: Where to search next when Dive Kit's references dataset has no answer: organisations, journal indexes, training agencies, forums and wikis, in the order to try them. A search source is a place to look, not a source Dive Kit relies on; vetted says whether what you find there can be cited as trustworthy.

generated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the dataset was last generated.

sources.description: Search sources in the order to try them: vetted sources first, community sources last.

id.description: Unique id, kebab-case, prefixed 'src-'; unique across this file and references.json. Example: 'src-dan'.

name.description: Name of the site or organisation.

kind.description: organisation: a research, medical or safety body; journal_index: a journal or paper index; agency: a training agency; forum: a discussion board; encyclopedia: a wiki or reference site.

use_for.description: One sentence: what to search this source for.

topics.description: Guide topics this source is good for; the same list as references.json.

vetted.description: true: a research, medical or agency source whose content can be cited; false: community content to verify against a vetted source.

how_to_search.description: One sentence on how to search it, e.g. 'site:dan.org <question>'.

notes.description: Optional caveats, such as how far to trust it or a host that blocks automated checks.

checked_at.description: Date the URL was last verified to resolve.
